mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.25%) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.5%, the market anticipates central bank monetary easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of falling federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.15%) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.5%) signals an aggressive monetary easing cycle, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction term in a regression has a negative coefficient with p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of housing market expansion (HOUST > 500 thousand units and RSAFS > 350,000 million dollars), rising consumer confidence and spending drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 500 and RSAFS > 350000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth (PAYEMS rising) increases household income and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS is rising, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST > 520) and industrial production (INDPRO > 99.5) indicates broad economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction term in a regression has a negative coefficient with p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of industrial expansion (INDPRO > 100), rising manufacturing output supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO > 100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
